rnp.runRateHint: Month forecast: month-to-date fact / elapsed days × days in month; % of the month plan
rnp.noMetrics: No metrics in this unit yet
rnp.unitNotAvailable: Unit not found or not available
rnp.legend: Green — plan met, yellow — at risk (between the thresholds), red — below the threshold, grey — no plan. Month fact is the sum of weeks (ratios are recomputed). Pencil — manual entry.

view.title: Metric order and visibility
view.hint: Only for you: untick to hide a metric, use the arrows to reorder. Data and permissions do not change.
view.keepOne: Keep at least one metric visible.

actions.subtitle: Base functions, roadmap and Execution rate of the unit
actions.legend: Execution rate = done / planned: base function checks and roadmap items due in the period whose deadline has passed (or that are already done). Click a check: done → not done → clear.

tokens.subtitle: A token lets a head's script push facts of the "script" metrics of its unit and the units below. The token is shown only once — store it right away.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.revokeConfirm: Revoke the token "{name}"? Its script will stop working.
tokens.nameRule: Lowercase latin letters, digits, ".", "_", "-"; 2–32 characters. E.g. cs-nps-script
tokens.unitRule: The script may write metrics of this unit and every unit below it
tokens.fillBoth: Fill in the name and the unit
tokens.createdOnce: Token "{name}" issued. Copy it now — it will not be shown again:
tokens.usage: The script sends values like this:

sync.subtitle: When the platform and Bitrix24 data were last updated (every 30 minutes, fully at night)

ai.notConfigured: AI is not configured: an administrator has to add the Anthropic API key on the server.

review.title: AI weekly review
review.thinking: AI is analysing the week: plan and fact, month forecast, actions. Usually under a minute.
review.empty: Press “Generate”: AI reviews the week of the unit — what is missed, what drags the month down and what to discuss.

assistant.title: AI assistant
assistant.subtitle: Answers from the dashboard data and shows where things are
assistant.intro: Ask about your unit's numbers or how the dashboard works. The assistant sees only what you can see and changes nothing.
examples: What is missed this week and why?
How did direct bookings change over 3 months compared to last year?
How do I enter a fact and who can set the plan?
What is run rate and how is it calculated?
assistant.hint: Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line. Answers take up to a minute.

anomaly.title: Why: {name}
anomaly.thinking: AI is reading the metric's data…

deviation.title: Deviation review
deviation.draftHint: AI draft from the metric and department data — check and edit before saving.
deviation.reasonPlaceholder: E.g. ads were stopped for 3 days because of an unpaid invoice
deviation.actionPlaceholder: E.g. pay the invoice in advance, restore the budget by 15.11
deviation.addedRoadmap: Item added to the metric roadmap
deviation.addedSprint: Task added to this week's sprint

pace.hint: What each of the remaining {days} days has to bring to reach the plan, and the average pace since the 1st

calls.subtitle: Incoming calls from Bitrix24. A call that does not belong to the statistics (technical failure, spam, test, own call) leaves the incoming and the missed calls once the head approves.
calls.pendingHint: Requests wait for the head of the unit.
calls.pendingHintHead: Approve to leave the call out of the incoming and missed calls, reject to keep it. The decision is final.
calls.listHint: Find your call by its time or Bitrix card and request an exclusion with a reason. Calls from {date} can be excluded.
calls.empty: No missed incoming calls in this period.
calls.requestTitle: Exclude the call from the statistics
calls.requestHint: The call leaves the incoming and missed-calls statistics only after the head of the unit approves.
calls.reasonPlaceholder: E.g. the office internet was down 10:00–10:40
calls.recalcLater: Decision saved. The statistics update with the next sync (within 30 minutes).
calls.requestHintHead: You are the head of the unit: the call leaves the incoming and missed-calls statistics at once, with no separate approval. The decision is final.
calls.emptyAll: No incoming calls in this period.
calls.categoryLabel: Why the call does not count
calls.imageHint: PNG, JPG or WebP up to 4 MB.
calls.imageWrongType: Only PNG, JPG or WebP images can be attached.
calls.imageTooBig: The image is larger than 4 MB.
calls.imageUnreadable: The file could not be read.
